name: Ecomcx SEO
author: Ecomcx
description: Tối ưu tìm kiếm toàn diện: tiêu đề & meta theo mẫu, chấm điểm nội dung theo từ khoá, schema JSON-LD, sitemap (thường, tin tức, video), chuyển hướng, theo dõi 404, breadcrumbs, SEO hình ảnh, IndexNow, Google Search Console, phân tích website và đối thủ.

ai.summary: Full SEO suite: title/meta templates, per-post SEO box with 0-100 keyword score, JSON-LD schema, sitemaps (news, video), redirects, 404 monitor, breadcrumbs, IndexNow, Search Console, GA4/GTM, llms.txt.
useWhen: the site needs search-engine optimisation (meta titles, descriptions, schema, sitemaps)
writing or editing posts that should score well for a focus keyword
redirects after URL changes or tracking 404 errors
pages need breadcrumbs, a table of contents, an FAQ list, local contact info or an HTML sitemap
avoidWhen: another SEO plugin already outputs meta tags and JSON-LD (avoid duplicates)
ai.provides: shortcodes [ecx_breadcrumbs], [ecx_toc levels title], [ecx_faq], [ecx_contact_info show], [ecx_html_sitemap types limit]; document metadata + robots.txt filters; JSON-LD @graph in body.end; GA4/GTM in head; routes /news-sitemap.xml, /video-sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, /indexnow-key.txt; per-post SEO in extra.ecxSeo; admin SEO menu (dashboard, redirects, 404, analysis, Search Console, settings); AI skill seo-writing
ai.notes: Do not hand-write <title>, meta description or JSON-LD in themes or pages when this plugin is on: it outputs them. Themes should not print their own BreadcrumbList schema (the plugin handles breadcrumbs.schema).
